raw.query: SELECT w.window_name, w.tp_star, w.n_star, v.llm_cost_ratio_vs_static FROM provenance.grid_window_effective w JOIN provenance.v_grid_static_vs_optimal v ON w.window_name = v.window_name ORDER BY w.window_name
raw.observed: burst1-6: ratio 1.00 (optimal TP2x2 with 4 GPUs); steady24h (calm): ratio 0.50 (optimal TP1x2 with 2 GPUs)
raw.claimed: Language fleet cost on burst windows is ~static optimum (ratio ~1.0); cross-window saving on calm traffic is TP1x2 using 2 GPUs (half the burst fleet's 4 GPUs)
raw.evidence: In grid_window_effective and v_grid_static_vs_optimal, optimal burst window LLM configurations are TP2x2 (4 GPUs, cost ratio ~1.00 vs static), whereas calm traffic (steady24h) uses TP1x2 (2 GPUs, cost ratio 0.50 vs static).
